entity.description: One thing a tenant needs to be true at month end, in the tenant's own words, e.g. gorjana's R4 "Every refund we give a customer is booked in NetSuite at the same amount...".

field.name: statementId
field.description: Globally unique row id, e.g. GORJANA_R4. Never shown; the JSON uses statementCode.

field.name: statementCode
field.description: The tenant's label for the statement, e.g. R4. The JSON statement id; unique per tenant.

field.name: categoryEnumId
field.description: Enumeration of type MonthCloseCategory; its enumCode is the JSON category id.

field.name: weightEnumId
field.description: Enumeration of type MonthCloseStatementWeight: firm (the tenant said it) or derived (inferred from production problems, awaiting the tenant's confirmation).

field.name: statementText
field.description: The statement verbatim, in the tenant's words.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Order of statements in the report.

entity.description: One check that tests one or more statements, usually a saved run on a daily schedule. Its findings land on the ledger (DAR-BE-089) under this check. The three templates are plain text with {name} placeholders, replaced literally from the finding's fields; they are NEVER expanded as Groovy or FTL, because tenant configuration must not be able to run code.

field.name: checkId
field.description: Globally unique row id. Never shown; the JSON uses checkCode.

field.name: checkCode
field.description: Kebab-case slug, e.g. returns-vs-credit-memos. The JSON check id; unique per tenant.

field.name: label
field.description: What the check compares, in a few words.

field.name: savedRunId
field.description: The saved run (RuleSet) that executes the check. Blank until the run is configured.

field.name: graceDays
field.description: Days a new finding stays pending before it counts as open. Blank means 0.

field.name: matchedBy
field.description: The shared id the two sides join on, in words, e.g. "return id (custbody_hc_return_id)". Blank for a one-sided check.

field.name: fixOwner
field.description: The team that fixes this check's findings, e.g. HotWax Support.

field.name: fixWhereEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system where the fix is made (OMS, NETSUITE or SHOPIFY of type DarpanSystemSource), never an endpoint.

field.name: headlineTemplate
field.description: One-line finding headline, e.g. "Credit memo is {differenceAbs} less than the refund for return {returnId}". At most 120 characters once filled, no trailing period.

field.name: fixActionTemplate
field.description: What to change, filled with the finding's values.

field.name: passesWhenTemplate
field.description: What the next scheduled check must see for the finding to close.

entity.description: Which check tests which statement. Many-to-many: one comparison serves several statements (returns against credit memos covers R4, R6, R7, R8, R9, R14 and R16), and one statement can need two checks (R1: invoiced orders and cash sales). Stamped with the tenant like both parents, so the filter applies to it directly.

field.name: sequenceNum
field.description: Order of a statement's checks in the report.

entity.description: One record that breaks one statement, as found by one check. Identity is (tenant, check, statement, recordKey): the same record found again on a later morning is the same finding, and one record that breaks two statements of one check is two findings.

field.name: findingId
field.description: F-<n>. The stored id and the JSON id are the same string.

field.name: recordKey
field.description: The check's key for the record, e.g. the OMS return id; stable across mornings.

field.name: stateEnumId
field.description: MonthCloseFindingState: MCFS_PENDING inside the check's grace age, MCFS_OPEN after it, MCFS_FIXED once a complete check looked at the record and no longer reported it.

field.name: firstFoundDate
field.description: The morning (tenant calendar day) a check first reported it. Kept when the finding reopens.

field.name: lastSeenDate
field.description: The latest morning a check still reported it.

field.name: lastCheckedStamp
field.description: When a check last looked at the record, whether or not it reported it.

field.name: timesSeen
field.description: Mornings on which a check reported it, counting the first.

field.name: closedByTypeEnumId
field.description: MonthCloseActorType of what closed it; in v1 always MCAT_CHECK.

field.name: closedById
field.description: The check (checkId) that closed it.

field.name: differenceAmount
field.description: actualAmount - expectedAmount; blank when either side is blank.

field.name: ruleText
field.description: The exact condition the record failed, in plain words.

field.name: conclusionEnumId
field.description: DarpanConclusion reached for the record; blank when no conclusion rule matched.

field.name: diagnosisText
field.description: DAR-BE-090. One sentence on what the conclusion means for this record; the finding JSON's diagnosis.explanation. Blank falls back to the conclusion's description.

entity.description: One id of the finding in one system. Replaced on every sighting, so it always shows what the latest check read.

field.name: systemEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system (OMS, NETSUITE, SHOPIFY of DarpanSystemSource), resolved through parentEnumId when the row is written; never an endpoint such as OMS_RETURNS_GQL.

field.name: recordType
field.description: camelCase singular, e.g. return, creditMemo, rma (contract "Records").

field.name: recordId
field.description: The id a person searches by, e.g. a NetSuite tranId or an OMS returnId.

field.name: internalId
field.description: The system's own key when it differs from recordId.

field.name: recordStatus
field.description: The record's status in its own system's words, when the check read it.

entity.description: One sub-condition of the finding's evidence, in order. Replaced on every sighting.

field.name: checkValue
field.description: What was seen, e.g. "160.22 vs 160.23".

entity.description: One row of a finding's history: found, stillOpen, fixed or reopened. Append-only.

field.name: eventDate
field.description: The morning (tenant calendar day) of the event; a past report reads state from the last event on or before its date.

entity.description: One check on one morning. A second run the same morning replaces the first (unique on tenant, check and reportDate), so the report always shows the latest run.

field.name: reportDate
field.description: The morning the check ran, as a tenant calendar day.

field.name: checkedDay
field.description: The tenant calendar day the check's window covered, normally the day before reportDate.

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: MonthCloseCheckStatus derived from the reads: MCCS_RAN when every read was complete, MCCS_PARTIAL when any was partial or failed, MCCS_NOT_RUN when the check did not run.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the check was partial or did not run, in plain words; blank when it ran.

field.name: runStamp
field.description: When the run was recorded.

entity.description: One extract a check run made from one system, and how it ended.

field.name: systemEnumId
field.description: The ROOT system (OMS, NETSUITE, SHOPIFY), resolved through parentEnumId when written.

field.name: endpointEnumId
field.description: The endpoint that read it, e.g. OMS_RETURNS_GQL, as given by the run.

field.name: statusEnumId
field.description: MonthCloseSourceRead: MCSR_COMPLETE, MCSR_PARTIAL or MCSR_FAILED.

field.name: recordCount
field.description: Records read; blank when the read failed before counting.

field.name: readStamp
field.description: When the read finished; blank when it failed.

field.name: reason
field.description: Why the read was partial or failed, in plain words; blank when complete.
